command:
export PATH=/var/jb/usr/bin:/var/jb/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/usr/sbin:/bin:/sbin
echo "PRE_WS=$(launchctl list 2>/dev/null | awk '$3=="UIKitApplication:com.macwsguide.windowserver"{print $1}')"
echo "PRE_TCCD=$(launchctl list 2>/dev/null | awk '$3=="com.macwsguide.tccd-system"{print $1}')"
WS=$(launchctl list 2>/dev/null | awk '$3=="UIKitApplication:com.macwsguide.windowserver"{print $1}')
[ -n "$WS" ] || { echo NO_WS; exit 1; }
kill -TERM "$WS"
echo "KILLED=$WS rc=$?"
i=0
while [ $i -lt 36 ]; do
  i=$((i+1)); sleep 5
  NOW_WS=$(launchctl list 2>/dev/null | awk '$3=="UIKitApplication:com.macwsguide.windowserver"{print $1}')
  NOW_TCCD=$(launchctl list 2>/dev/null | awk '$3=="com.macwsguide.tccd-system"{print $1}')
  echo "T+${i}x5s WS=$NOW_WS TCCD=$NOW_TCCD"
  [ -n "$NOW_WS" ] && [ "$NOW_WS" != "$WS" ] && echo "RECOVERY_WS_OBSERVED"
  [ -n "$NOW_TCCD" ] && [ "$NOW_TCCD" != "$(launchctl list 2>/dev/null | awk '$3=="com.macwsguide.tccd-system"{print $1}')" ] || true
  if [ -n "$NOW_WS" ] && [ "$NOW_WS" != "$WS" ] && [ -n "$NOW_TCCD" ]; then break; fi
done
echo "=== WATCHDOG LOG"
grep -E "reconnecting|recovered|tccd transport|did not recover|replacement WindowServer|GUI clients reconnected" /var/jb/var/mobile/macos_gui_watchdog.log 2>/dev/null | tail -12
echo "=== TCCD PRINT"
launchctl print user/501/com.macwsguide.tccd-system 2>&1 | grep -E "state =|pid =|com.apple.macosbooter" | head -6
echo "=== FINAL"
ps -axo pid,etime,command | grep "Resources/WindowServer" | grep -v grep
